messages.subject: Recent maintenance on glimmer
parts:
Hi everyone -

Just a quick notice about Glimmer: Due to a bug in the installed version of node.js, there was an issue on Glimmer where R sessions wouldn't get cleaned up after a connection was closed. This resulted in a lot of useless processes hanging around, and runaway memory consumption. You may have noticed a few hiccups in Glimmer's service today because of our work fixing the issue, but everything should be good now.

-Winston
